title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
one_liner: NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩到仓储机群：写时不生成描述按需缓存 token 解码，服务器计算大降，人像置零过 GDPR，450 次解码输出全复现
summary_zh: 仓储机器人机群持续观察运营状况，但把观察存成可复用语义记忆的计算通信与存储成本高解释反复的通道堵塞需要跨机器人跨班次回看视频Industrial ReMEmbR 把 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展为机群共享时空记忆系统，通过只在按需取回时生成场景描述来削减服务器端计算每台 Jetson 用 Cosmos-Embed1 编码视频片段的检索 embeddingCosmos3-Edge 编码 vision tokenWan2.2 VAE 编码重建 latent，不上传原始相机帧；同一批编码模型复用于检测图像 patch 中的人并置零，支持 GDPR 合规的 PII 抽象系统在 vision-language 边界切开 Cosmos3-Edge：视觉编码器留在机器人语言解码器放在本地服务器；Nemotron agent 按内容位置与时间检索记忆，并用缓存的 vision token 查询解码器设计消除了写时 caption 生成，450 次测试解码中缓存 token 解码全部复现未切分模型的输出
summary_en: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operations, but preserving observations as reusable semantic memory incurs heavy compute, communication, and storage cost explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across shifts. Industrial ReMEmbR extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to a fleet-shared spatiotemporal memory that generates scene descriptions only on demand. Each Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings (Cosmos-Embed1), vision tokens (Cosmos3-Edge), and reconstruction latents (Wan2.2 VAE) without uploading raw frames; the encoders are reused to detect people in patches and zero them out for GDPR-compliant PII abstraction....
